info.title: Restormel Keys API
info.description:
Zuplo Gateway API for Restormel Keys. Consumer keys (zpka_...) authenticate at the edge; inbound policies forward to the dashboard with a backend Gateway key (rk_...). Control-plane CRUD uses /api/* on KEYS_BACKEND_URL. Runtime hot paths (Phase 1+) use /keys/v1/* on KEYS_SITE_ORIGIN (site root, e.g. https://restormel.dev).

Rate-limit headers: all endpoints with rate-limit-inbound in their policy stack emit X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset on every response. Zuplo emits these automatically; no backend change required.

Changelog:
- 1.9.0 (2026-06-10): [1.1] Verified-context envelope. POST /connect/v1/retrieve and POST /connect/v1/graph responses now carry verified_claims (one VerifiedClaim per returned unit: EBV verification state supported|inferred|unverified|contradicted|excluded, bound evidence spans with offsets + source-version hash, latest entailment judge attribution, citation, provenance trace link, trust score) plus metadata.verification_summary per-state counts. Additive, backward compatible. Guide: /keys/docs/guides/verified-context.
- 1.8.0 (2026-06-08): [4C] Verification rule set v1. New GET /connect/v1/verification-rules returns the rule set active for a workspace (six-dimension weights + strict/balanced/lenient policies); GET /connect/v1/verification-rules/built-in returns the built-in Restormel Core v1 definition.
- 1.7.0 (2026-06-08): [4B] Provenance audit trace export. POST /connect/v1/retrieve and POST /connect/v1/graph now return a trace_id. New GET /connect/v1/traces/{traceId} returns the structured, versioned ProvenanceTrace; GET /connect/v1/traces/{traceId}/export?format=json downloads it. Traces are retained for 90 days.
- 1.6.0 (2026-06-07): [C1] Cursor pagination on GET /connect/v1/ingest/jobs (?limit, ?cursor, next_cursor, total_count). [C2] Idempotency-Key header support on POST /connect/v1/ingest/jobs (24-hour TTL). [C3] X-Request-Id header on all Connect v1, Keys v1, and Graph v1 responses (echoed in error envelopes as request_id). [C4] Rate-limit response headers documented (X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset — Zuplo already emits). [C5] GET /graph/v1/snapshots/{snapshotId} now returns 501 not_implemented instead of 404 (Graph snapshots planned for Phase 6). [1A] Connect v1 ingest/retrieve/verify API with workspace-scoped persistence. [1B] Keys v1 routing surface. [1C] GraphStoreAdapter unification + RetrievalConfig. [1D] Ingest contract completion: quality reports, log streaming, outbound webhooks. [2A] Neo4j adapter + graph store config panel. [2B] O1/O2 breaking changes: contract_version snake_case, /connect/v1/retrieve 206 on degraded.
- 1.1.0 (2026-06-07): [O1 BREAKING] contractVersion field renamed to contract_version (snake_case) in resolve, simulate, and catalog responses. Update any consumers reading this field. [O2 BREAKING] /connect/v1/retrieve now returns HTTP 206 (Partial Content) instead of 200 when retrieval_degraded:true. [I4] /graph/v1/layout now requires authentication (gateway key, management key, or session). [I5] New /keys/v1/management-keys endpoints (POST/GET/DELETE) for management key lifecycle. [I9] GET /keys/v1/connections and GET /keys/v1/connections/{connectionId} now accept gateway keys (read-only).

post.description: Creates a new knowledge ingest job. Supports idempotency: include an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string, max 256 chars) to safely retry without creating duplicate jobs. The same key returns the original 201 response for 24 hours.

Read-only. Returns a single source connection by ID for the caller's workspace. Auth: gateway key, management key, or session (I9).

consumerKey.description: A Zuplo consumer key (zpka_...). Send as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

VerifiedClaim.description: Verified-claim envelope (per the Evidence-Bound Verification ADR): one per returned unit on retrieval responses. Carries the full verification chain — claim, EBV state, bound evidence spans (quote + offsets + source-version hash, deterministically re-checkable without a model), latest entailment judge attribution, citation, provenance trace link, and trust score. A skeptical consumer can fetch the cited source version and check the quote at its offsets themselves.

id.description: Graph record id of the claim.

state.description: EBV verification state. supported = evidence-bound (deterministic Layer-1 span check) AND entailed (Layer-2 judge); inferred = entailed but no directly bound span (always labeled as inference); unverified = judge abstained, low confidence, or no bindable evidence (review queue); contradicted = evidence entails the negation; excluded = reversible remediation/operator soft-exclude. Non-supported units are flagged, never silently blended.

evidence.description: Bound evidence spans. Empty when no evidence could be bound — such a claim is at best inferred, never supported.

quote.description: Evidence quote, verbatim as bound at extraction time.

offsets.description: [start, end) character offsets into the ORIGINAL source version text.

source_ref.description: Graph record reference of the CITED source (e.g. source:abc123).

source_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the source version the span was bound against.

match.description: Match strictness; anything looser than exact is labeled, never hidden.

judge.description: Latest span-scoped entailment judgment (EBV Layer 2). Omitted when the claim has not been judged. Verdicts are recorded append-only with model id, prompt version, and timestamp, so every verdict is attributable and re-runnable.

citation.description: Human-readable source citation (the cited source's title).

trace_ref.description: Provenance trace link for the query that returned this claim (/connect/v1/traces/{trace_id}); null when trace persistence was unavailable.

trust_score.description: Graph trust score 0–100 for this claim, when the graph supplies one.

VerificationSummary.description: Per-state counts over a response's verified_claims — gate on "anything non-supported in this context?" without scanning every envelope.

ConnectRetrieveResponse.description: ConnectRetrieveResponse (canonical Zod schema: @restormel/contracts/connect). Verified-context fields are additive: verified_claims + metadata.verification_summary.

trace_id.description: Provenance trace id; fetch the full audit trace at GET /connect/v1/traces/{trace_id}.

verified_claims.description: Verified-claim envelope per returned unit (matched by claim.id, not position).

ConnectGraphOpResponse.description: ConnectGraphOpResponse (canonical Zod schema: @restormel/contracts/connect). Verified-context fields are additive: verified_claims + metadata.verification_summary.

trace_id.description: Provenance trace id; fetch the full audit trace at GET /connect/v1/traces/{trace_id}.

subgraph.description: Curated subgraph; each claim also carries verification_state, trust_score, and verification_category.

verified_claims.description: Verified-claim envelope per subgraph claim (matched by claim.id).

trace.description: Trace summary (seed/claim/relation counts, verification policy counts).

VerificationRuleSet.description: A versioned verification rule set: how each of the six reasoning dimensions is weighted and the policies that classify a claim as supported / weak / unsupported. Scores are on a 0–1 scale.

weight.description: 0–1; weights across the six dimensions sum to 1.0.

min_overall_score.description: Overall score (0–1) at/above which a claim is supported.

weak_threshold.description: At/above this (but below min_overall_score) a claim is weak; below it, unsupported.

ProvenanceTrace.description: Structured, versioned audit trace for a retrieval query. schema_version is bumped only on breaking changes; consumers must tolerate unknown fields.

payload.description: Tool-specific arguments (e.g. topic, content+format, traceJson, graphJson, eventsJson).

environments.description: Optional. Present when expanded by the backend.

KeyInfo.description: A Gateway Key. Full key is shown only at creation time.

QualityReport.description: Ingest quality assessment. Nullable: present only once validation has run for the job.

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass as ?cursor= in the next request. Null when no further pages.

total_count.description: Total number of ingest jobs for the workspace (across all pages).

secret.description: Optional signing secret; generated when omitted.

ConnectIngestJob.description: A workspace-scoped Knowledge Ingest job, persisted to Postgres.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique identifier for this request, echoed in error envelopes as request_id. Generated by the server if not present in the incoming request.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the current window resets.
